resolutionRules.component: Instances reference a map component; artPoolId and behavior defaults come from its catalog record.
resolutionRules.gameplay: Start with owner tile gameplay; non-null component scalar defaults replace associations, component arrays add unique IDs; explicit instance overrides replace a field (null disables an association).
resolutionRules.optional: A placement rule reuses its discovery pool spawnChance, weights, entry componentId and revealTrigger. Do not roll a second independent spawn chance.
resolutionRules.density: Routes do not occupy the landmark slot. Optional placement excludes authored landmark tiles and uses a global cap ceil(eligibleTileCount * maxOccupiedFraction), with at most one optional landmark per tile.
resolutionRules.art: Tile propsPoolId mirrors the first authored object for compatibility; objectIds/componentId are authoritative.
resolutionRules.level: Objects inherit the tile level band unless an instance explicitly overrides it.
